headline: Advances in Quantum Algorithms, Simulations, and Hardware
summary: Today's research features significant theoretical and practical strides across quantum computing, ranging from optimal complexity bounds for ground-state preparation and linear systems to novel hardware platforms and accelerated simulation techniques for materials and lattice gauge theories.

themes.title: Quantum Algorithms & Complexity
themes.body: New theoretical results establish optimal query complexities and algorithm designs for ground-state preparation, linear systems, and the abelian state hidden subgroup problem.

themes.title: Quantum Simulations & Dynamics
themes.body: Research advances simulation efficiency through parameter transfer strategies for battery materials and multilevel plaquette-space sampling for lattice gauge theories.

themes.title: Quantum Hardware & Optics
themes.body: A novel silicon-on-SiC photonic platform enables high-purity single-photon emission from shallow vanadium dopants in the telecom O-band.

connections.body: Both papers focus on optimizing query and computational complexities to solve fundamental quantum simulation and linear system problems.
